# `nxsp`

Run per-ROI Squidpy/NetworkX spatial graph metrics (assortativity, per-population clustering, bootstrapped nulls, and case aggregation)

- Wrapper: [`job_networkx_spatial.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_networkx_spatial.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_cellcharter`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.networkx_spatial`

## Inputs

- networkx_spatial.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- adata.obs keys configured in networkx_spatial (population_obs, roi_obs, case_obs optional, X/Y coords)

## Outputs

- general.qc_folder/networkx_spatial.output_subdir (default QC/NetworkX_Spatial)

## Configuration

- general, process, networkx_spatial, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl nxsp
```
